1.

The blood of Jesus has opened for us The way to God. Happy is he who now receives The call of grace.

2.

Only through this blood Is there forgiveness. God can now freely grant pardon To all.

3.

Yes, the transgressor who in sin Otherwise must die, Through the blood of Jesus can become White as snow.

4.

Now we draw near to the Holy One With a holy boldness; For to God Jesus has purchased us With His blood.

5.

Who can comprehend the value of the blood, This holy stream, Which still proclaims God’s love, Deep and tender!

6.

Lord Jesus, we thank Thee For Thy precious blood, Thou who gavest Thy life for the sheep, Good Shepherd!
